subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"restricted"** means limited in extent, number, or action. (प्रतिबंधित)

 
 
• **Example:** The building had** restricted **access for security reasons.
 
 
 
• In the context, "restricted access to food" fits well, indicating limited availability of food resources, which aligns with the themes of famines and food scarcity. (भोजन तक सीमित पहुंच)
 
 
• **Example:** Overexploitation of farmers led to restricted access to food for the general population.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **restricted**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **Inflated** (फुला हुआ): Increased beyond normal levels; exaggerated.

 
 
• **Example:** The **inflated** prices made basic necessities unaffordable.
 
 
 
• **Unlimited** (असीमित): Not restricted; having no limits.
 
 
• **Example:** The charity offered** unlimited **support to those in need.
 
 
 
• **Basic** (मूलभूत): Fundamental and necessary.
 
 
• **Example:** The** basic** needs of food and shelter are essential for survival.
 
 

44:Tc78,
The correct answer is O
